body: Chief full-basis ruling read. I am preparing the required independent review against the exact original 13 plus 17-path envelope. My court will check: LocalCostModel.cost and externalCost are fallible with no rejection-blind compatibility door; one checked SupportBasis is explicit at every GraphHsmm infer and ablation invocation and reaches every producer; GraphHsmm/HsmmResult rebuild or validate every CostBreakdown against that basis; hsmm/v4 carries the basis canonically; embedded basis licenses internal consistency only, while any authenticated invocation-provenance claim requires an independently supplied expected basis or receipt; custom models cannot mint stronger authority; non-finite and aggregate-overflow inputs refuse before output; CostBreakdown and basis construction doors remain shut from both packages; v3 refusal and v4 exact-byte court remain. This records review focus only, adds no scope and requests no early candidate.
